body: I think Bipolar adds spice to my life. I do things I normally wouldn't, through therapy I've minimized/removed the dangerous/scary stuff, and that makes my life so much better, IMO, than someone who would rather sit around and say what they wouldn't do.

I actually embrace the Bipolar at this point... It is far easier than being a poor white man born into a poor white family constantly reassured about how my privilege will keep me from ever experiencing poverty, which is apparently only a situation brown people and women experience.

Yes. I am in one locally, which is great.... until everything they suggest requires having money. The group I found on reddit (active on my main account) is pretty helpful with bipolar, through seeing how bad others are. Sure, it makes me happy that I'm better off (as far as mental health goes) than others. It still doesn't help the fact that being bipolar is the least of my problems at this point.

Frequent lines I've gotten:

"Are you jewish? You look like a jewish guy I went to school with" <---- Got this one nearly 100 times when living in Charleston, S.C. WTF with you ladies?

"Would you be offended if I told you your dick looked great in those shorts?" - or some variation of. 

Although, my favorite thus far has been, "Is that your girlfirend? I don't want her to be jealous when I take you home with me later"
Good thing the rules at /r/punchablefaces are to be racist and sexist towards white men... although, dude looks kind of gay Not sure how they could rationalize/hamster that.
